nominee.longerDescription: HAPPY WW! This might be my happiest wws other than nominating my own GF tbh! Cannot believe I am actually here to witness this! While I am writing this I am listening to the loading screen music that got revealed 8 days ago when you were able to preload the game. I absolutely love the ambience, it just fills me with so much joy, excitement and nostalgia to the older games, it will be fantastic to look at Chiquin's look alike to if I am not looking at the poster :P. When I first played GTA at around 4-5 years old (explains a lot xd) I never knew this game would shape my life! San Andreas was the first, I probably put like 10k hours into it if we count everything modded as well. During these hours I played Vice City and GTA 3, then at one point GTA 4 came out and I was so happy to play it after months of the release on my brother's PC with about 18 fps at times :D Lowkey tearing up a lil ngl.... then at one point came GTA 5 that my brother surprised me with on one of the last days of 8th grade and it was SO FUCKING PEAK. Rockstar Games you have my heart! Even at uni on a throwaway optional class (gaming class lol) I wrote about the game. When 6 was revealed I was at MIK, although I have seen the trailer a day before due to the leaks, but it motivated me a lot to graduate. It would have aligned well with my graduation but damn Rockstar delayed it, it would have been great with the 8th graduation + now the uni but oh well. Video games have always been my escape where I could be whoever I want and GTA always delivered. I loved all the (so far) male protagonists, each so unique and interesting. However this time,  FOR THE FIRST TIME in history we will be playing with a female protagonist, this week's nominee, Lucia Caminos a.k.a Manni L. Perez (99.999999% confirmed). The fact that the first female is a latina makes it all much betteron my end!  I love her looks, the voice and can't wait to get to know her character a lot more :P! Interestingly, due to some leaker I have seen her naked already LOL She is lacking quite a lot in the boob department but she makes up all of it in the booty aisle.. However I have nominated the actor not the character, so let's dive into :P Manni! Tbh she keeps it quite lowkey, Rockstar NDA's are always super strict and its crazy to me that she cannot talk about anything related to the game for 4 years since the first trailer has dropped. She at some point deleted her social media cause she didn't know how to deal with it and its silly that she has to make up random lies to keep the gag up that she is not Lucia when she literally is a carbon copy of her lol. At least they should have gave her a good script to go with because at one point she denied doing any work for gta then in the same interview she was like ooh hahahaha you mean a casino ?? oh yeah I didn't know who I was working for haha! such a small gig! haha like bro you are an actor I am sure you can lie better. Anyways, her personality is pretty chill, she is into fitness and says that she is an introverted extrovert(npc ahh description) but I think its quite average for a woman in her 30s. Don't get me wrong tho, its rare that they are this chill imo, I meant it about the silly humor they have not the being active. Thats all we know of her lol but I am sure with time we will get to know her more. For her relations to the game, very hot looks, love for the gym, she gets a record breaking, 10/10 HYPE!!!!! 📢📢📢📢 With this we have covered my 3rd and probably the longest planned WW out of the 4. Pretty easy to guess, but you know I had to do it.
